description: This file implements a transformation layer between Cohere's rerank API format and Jina AI's rerank API format. It defines a configuration class for the Jina AI rerank service, handles URL construction, request and response transformation, environment validation, and cost calculation. The core logic involves mapping parameters, constructing URLs, transforming response data structures, and ensuring proper API key management.

classes.name: JinaAIRerankConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for interfacing with Jina AI's rerank API, providing methods to generate supported parameters, URL, transform requests/responses, validate environment, and calculate cost.

methods.name: list get_supported_cohere_rerank_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of rerank parameters supported by the Jina AI rerank API for given models.

methods.name: Dict map_cohere_rerank_params( self, non_default_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, query: str, documents: List[Union[str, Dict[str, Any]]], custom_llm_provider: Optional[str] = None, top_n: Optional[int] = None, rank_fields: Optional[List[str]] = None, return_documents: Optional[bool] = True, max_chunks_per_doc: Optional[int] = None, max_tokens_per_doc: Optional[int] = None, )
methods.description: Maps non-default parameters to the supported rerank parameters for the Jina AI API.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the complete API URL for the rerank endpoint, optionally based on provided base URL.

methods.name: Dict transform_rerank_request( self, model: str, optional_rerank_params: Dict, headers: Dict )
methods.description: Transforms the request parameters to the format expected by Jina AI's rerank API.

methods.name: RerankResponse transform_rerank_response( self, model: str, raw_response: Response, model_response: RerankResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, api_key: Optional[str] = None, request_data: Dict = {}, optional_params: Dict = {}, litellm_params: Dict = {}, )
methods.description: Transforms the raw response from Jina AI into the format expected by LiteLLM, including converting document format and handling errors.

methods.name: Dict validate_environment( self, headers: Dict, model: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, )
methods.description: Validates presence of required environment variables such as API key and constructs headers for API requests.

methods.name: Tuple[float,float] calculate_rerank_cost( self, model: str, custom_llm_provider: Optional[str] = None, billed_units: Optional[RerankBilledUnits] = None, model_info: Optional[ModelInfo] = None, )
methods.description: Calculates cost based on token usage and model info, returning the estimated input cost for Jina AI reranker.
